get.summary: Retrieve the authenticated agent's own audit-log entries
get.description:
Returns a paginated, reverse-chronological list of audit-log rows scoped to the authenticated agent (matched by SHA-256 of the bearer key). Satisfies Privacy Act APP 12 self-serve access without operator mediation.

Rows are ordered `created_at DESC, id DESC`. Use `next_cursor` for keyset pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows per page. Capped at 500. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor returned as `next_cursor` from the previous response. Omit on the first request.

200.description: Paginated audit-log entries for the authenticated agent

before_json.description: Pre-state snapshot (raw JSON string) or null

after_json.description: Post-state snapshot (raw JSON string) or null

request_id.description: Correlation ID matching the application log entry

ip_country.description: ISO country code (coarse; never full IP)

next_cursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor for the next page. Null when `has_more` is false.

get.description: Resolves a legal citation string (instrument name + optional jurisdiction parenthetical + optional pinpoint suffix — sections as 's ###(#)', and for subordinate instruments 'r ##' / 'reg ##' / 'cl ##' / 'sch ##', e.g. 'Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) s 6' or 'Coal Mining Safety and Health Regulation 2017 (Qld) r 42') or a standards designation (e.g. 'AS/NZS 4308:2008') to a verified docId. Exact-title-first against legislation documents, then PACT topics. Never returns a fuzzy guess: anything below an exact or near-exact title match is a 404-style miss; same-title instruments across jurisdictions without a jurisdiction parenthetical return a 'citation_ambiguous' miss listing the candidates. Legislation hits also carry currency metadata (asAt, contentVersion, versionScope, amendment/commencement/repeal dates) and support a cheap `since=` change probe answered in the same response — no full-act refetch. Free and unauthenticated, like the other legislation reads.

parameters.name: citation
parameters.description: The citation to resolve, e.g. 'Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) s 6(1)' or 'Coal Mining Safety and Health Regulation 2017 (Qld) r 42' or 'AS/NZS 4308:2008'

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Cheap change-detection probe. Supply a previously returned contentVersion (exact match, preferred) or an ISO date (compared against asAt). The verdict rides back on this same response under `since` — one call, no full-act refetch. Unparseable values fail OPEN (changed: true), never a false 'unchanged'.

sectionRef.description: Resolved section/pinpoint id as STORED (e.g. 's 19' for an Act, 'r 89' for a Regulation, or 'chunk-2'); null when the requested pinpoint could not be verified

verifiedRef.description: Canonical verified citation string; includes the pinpoint only when sectionRef resolved, echoing the unit the resolved row uses (e.g. '… (Qld) r 89')

inForce.description: false when repealed, true when an in-force date is recorded, null when unknown (topics always null)

asAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the stored consolidation is current to: repeal date if repealed, else last amendment, else commencement, else record creation. Null for topics and undated rows.

contentVersion.description: Short stable digest (8 hex chars) over the currency-bearing fields. Pass back as `since` to detect change. Null for topics.

versionScope.description: What contentVersion covers. This endpoint returns 'metadata' (doc identity + dates; single-query and cheap). GET /api/axiom/legislation/{id} returns 'metadata+sections', which also detects a section rewrite that left the dates stuck. The two are DIFFERENT digests — always compare a stamp against the endpoint that issued it.

repealedDate.description: Repeal date (ISO date); non-null implies inForce false

pointInTimeSupported.description: Always false. Only CURRENT consolidations are stored — there is no point-in-time history, so a historical asAt request cannot be honoured and today's text must never be mistaken for a point-in-time answer.

since.description: Present only when the request supplied `since`. One-call change detection.

changed.description: True when the stored instrument differs from what the caller last saw. FAILS OPEN on an unparseable stamp.

404.description: Citation not resolved (error: citation_not_resolved) or ambiguous across jurisdictions (error: citation_ambiguous, with candidates[])

200.description: Search results with relevance scoring. Every hit carries `sectionKind`: `pinpoint` (a real, citable section id — `sourceRef` is `"<title> <sectionId>"`), `extract` (the section id is an internal storage key such as `chunk-1`; `sourceRef` degrades to the document-level citation and the id is never composed into it), or `claim` (a PACT topic hit; `sourceRef` is its curated citation). Cite `sourceRef` verbatim; treat `extract` hits as background from the instrument, not a pinpointed provision.

get.summary: Get a single piece of legislation

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Cheap change-detection probe. Supply a previously returned contentVersion (exact match, preferred) or an ISO date (compared against asAt). The verdict rides back on this same response under `since`. Unparseable values fail OPEN (changed: true). Note this endpoint issues a 'metadata+sections' scoped contentVersion — do not compare it against a stamp from /api/axiom/resolve.

200.description: Full legislation with sections, amendments, and metadata. Also carries currency fields: asAt, contentVersion (versionScope 'metadata+sections' — includes a fingerprint over every section's content, so it detects a section rewrite that left the dates stuck), versionScope, lastAmendedDate, inForceDate, repealedDate, pointInTimeSupported (always false — only current consolidations are stored), and `since` when the probe was requested. The contentVersion describes the WHOLE instrument even when `section=` narrowed the response.

get.description: Returns canonical material rates by stable item-key (e.g. wall-tile-porcelain) across all curator-linked AU retailers. Includes cheapest per key plus all observations for refinement (multi-retailer comparison, tier swaps). Public, unauthenticated. Cached 1h. Item keys with no current observation are listed in `missing[]`. Stale observations (>7d) are flagged via `stale: true`.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of item keys (1-64). See /api/market/quote-rates/keys for the full catalog.

post.summary: Submit completed work for validation + credit award
post.description: Two-stage validator for price_observation_mining: (1) deterministic checks (URL HEAD 200, retailer-domain match, sanity range, unit match); (2) consensus (within +/-10% of running median for same item_key+retailer over last 14 days). Accepted observations earn 2 credits and persist to market.price_observations. Outliers / cold-start / sanity-range violations land in market.price_observation_defects.

404.description: Assignment not found or not owned by agent

get.summary: Daily cron: open price_observation_mining assignments for stale (item_key, retailer) pairs
get.description: Sweeps active item keys x hardware retailers (bunnings, mitre-10, reece, beaumont-tiles, tradelink). Opens 1 assignment per pair whose latest observation is older than 24 hours (or never observed). Caps at 200 assignments per run. Each carries 2 credits and 24h TTL. Authorisation via Bearer ${CRON_SECRET}.

skipped.description: Pairs that already had an open/claimed assignment
